purpose: Fill seven narrow v148 Year 1 organic recall gaps after verifying related published card fronts/backs; no repeated multi-step exam prompts.

newCards.front: What does a general formula represent in organic chemistry?
newCards.back: The composition of a whole homologous series using a variable such as n.

newCards.front: Which type of radiation does the ozone layer absorb?
newCards.back: Much of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation.

newCards.front: Which intermolecular forces act between poly(ethene) chains?
Why do longer poly(ethene) chains usually have stronger attractions?
newCards.back: More electrons and greater contact area increase London dispersion forces.

newCards.front: Name one common use of rigid, unplasticised PVC.
Name one common use of flexible, plasticised PVC.
Which atmospheric gas made of hydrogen and oxygen absorbs Earth's infrared radiation?
